# Cookie

> A Jekyll and Tailwind CSS theme for landing pages, blogs, and docs.

Cookie builds to static HTML from plain Markdown content. Pages, blog posts, and docs are each a Jekyll collection with a clean permalink, so this file stays a small, accurate map of the site.

For the full text of every doc page in one fetch, see [llms-full.txt]({{ "/llms-full.txt" | absolute_url }}).

## Docs
{%- assign docs = site.docs | sort: "order" -%}
{%- for doc in docs %}
- [{{ doc.title }}]({{ doc.url | absolute_url }})
{%- endfor %}

## Blog
{%- for post in site.posts %}
- [{{ post.title }}]({{ post.url | absolute_url }})
{%- endfor %}
